fills: the occasion components after the fixed ones in Components
formula: for each supplied component, in order: its name unchanged, a role as a short noun phrase, then one paragraph
paragraph slot order: fill, border, radius, padding, type, contents, state, then an optional closing 'only' or 'never' line
type opens on the component's leadFact in the supplied fact role, when it has one, then the rest in title, body and label roles
rules: a fill var(--immersive-X) always with its text var(--immersive-on-X)

only a component whose roles include action names var(--immersive-action), for the page's main action; an action in any other component is the Secondary Action: no fill, its label and outline in the block's on- text variable
radius and padding as var(--borderRadius-…) and var(--space-…) from the supplied picks: a component with feature true takes the feature radius, every other the block radius
type as role names from typeRoles, such as title2 or body
a component with a leadFact sets that one fact in the supplied fact role and nothing else above title1; a component without one stops at title1
a block inside a feature component takes a lighter step of the same family, never a second family
exactly one entry per supplied component, in order, keeping its name

occasion.components.name: Kiln slot card
occasion.components.contentNotes: slot time, glaze rules, one action

components.name: Kiln slot card
components.paragraph: var(--immersive-palette-50) fill with var(--immersive-on-palette-50) text, no border, var(--borderRadius-400) corners and var(--space-3) padding. The slot time leads in display3 and fills the top of the card; the glaze rules follow in body, then one main action. Full slots show a plain label and never a disabled button.
